resources.string: A dim bedside clock on the always-on display while charging at night

string-array.item: While a Bedtime mode is on

resources.string: How bright the always-on display may get while Nightstand is on

Nightstand turns the always-on display on while it runs and puts it back after. It ends when the charger goes, the alarm rings or the night ends. The face only swaps between two custom faces; the system clock stays.
